substeps.caption: The Aero S's clear dome lifts; a vial of atomized powder (a few grams) is emptied into its hopper.
Dome down. A vibrating tray feeds the powder to a venturi in the cell bay; compressed air disperses it across the laser (drawn see-through).
The scattering pattern gives the size distribution, 0.1 um to 3.5 mm, in under a minute; the vacuum extractor takes the powder away.
